name: Hallow

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: incense worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a point you touch; the area is up to 60 feet in radius

summary: Consecrate an area up to 60 feet in radius against chosen kinds of creatures.
text: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead can't enter it or charm, frighten or possess anyone inside, and its dead can't be raised as Undead. You also bind one extra effect to it, such as courage, darkness, daylight, energy protection, fear or tongues.
